recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-17719; any future desire to represent kilogram-of-water-specific UCUM annotations in ucum-common should be handled as a new terminology decision because FHIR-36012 changed the policy for annotated UCUM codes.
issue_request: FHIR-17719 was a Published/Persuasive Vocab STU3 correction asking to fix invalid UCUM mmol/kg[H20]; the approved resolution was mmol/kg{H2O}.
initial_application: Git commit 00cae9abb1 (GF#17719 - fix ucum code) changed source/valueset/valueset-ucum-common.xml from mmol/kg{H20} to mmol/kg{H2O}, with a source comment noting the original mmol/kg[H20] form was invalid. No prior Issue-Reconcile-Key: FHIR-17719 commit existed on the combined branch before this run.
additional_context: Current source no longer contains the invalid H20 form or the water-specific mmol/kg{H2O} concept. The all-UCUM ValueSet source includes the UCUM code system rather than enumerating concepts, and the active ucum-common ValueSet is in build scope through the active ValueSet resource and source/valueset/list-ValueSet-examples.xml. Later Published issue FHIR-36012 removed UCUM curly-brace comments from ucum-units and ucum-common and deduplicated resulting codes, explaining why current ucum-common contains mmol/kg rather than mmol/kg{H2O}.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current source is correct when FHIR-17719 is read together with the historical fix and later FHIR-36012 normalization.

related_jiras.note: Published cleanup that removed curly-brace UCUM comments from ucum-units and ucum-common, explaining why mmol/kg{H2O} is no longer present in current source.
Broader invalid-UCUM report from the same Zulip thread was Resolved - No Change and was not independently reconciled here.
